title: GEOLYTIX XYZ v4.23.4 workspace
description: Closed capability contract for the audited workspace surface of the pinned GEOLYTIX XYZ framework. Unsupported properties are rejected, not silently removed.

dbs.description: Default database connection. XYZ resolves this as the DBS_<value> environment variable.

roles.description: Workspace role declarations returned by XYZ's workspace roles endpoint.

locale.description: Default locale and the locale used by this instance.

locales.description: Optional named locales. Each property name is a locale key.

templates.description: XYZ query, locale, layer, view, message, or module templates keyed by their lookup name.

src.description: Provider-qualified source loaded lazily by XYZ, for example file: or URL provider syntax supported by the deployment.

template.description: Inline SQL, HTML, message, or other template text.

module.description: Treat a fetched string as an ECMAScript module.

nonblocking.description: Return HTTP 202 without awaiting completion of a query template.

value_only.description: Return the first value from the first query row.

reduce.description: Reduce query rows to a flat values array.

roleMap.description: Role names, including wildcard * and negated !role names, mapped to an access flag or object merged for that role.

relation.description: An unquoted PostgreSQL table or schema.table name.

color.description: CSS hexadecimal colour. XYZ/OpenLayers accepts short and alpha forms as well as six-digit colours.

role.description: Optional role restriction understood by XYZ.

roles.description: Role map used by XYZ's access and role-specific composition logic.

mapviewControls.description: OpenLayers control constructor names. XYZ ignores names absent from ol.control.

ScaleLine.description: Scale-line units supported by XYZ v4.23.4.

plugins.description: Plugin module references dynamically loaded for this locale.

syncPlugins.description: Plugin keys loaded sequentially before map use.

svgTemplates.description: SVG template keys mapped to source URLs.

svg_templates.description: Legacy alias for svgTemplates retained by XYZ v4.23.4.

admin.description: Bundled plugin adding an administrator link for an authenticated XYZ administrator.

consent.description: Bundled plugin requesting and persisting consent for an authenticated user.

custom_theme.description: Bundled plugin applying locale CSS colour variables.

dark_mode.description: Bundled plugin adding a persisted light/dark colour-mode toggle.

feature_info.description: Bundled plugin adding a map feature-identification interaction.

fullscreen.description: Bundled plugin adding the XYZ fullscreen-layout toggle.

layer_order.description: Bundled plugin ordering decorated layers by layer key.

link_button.description: Bundled plugin adding one or more configured links to the map button column.

zoomBtn.description: Bundled plugin adding zoom-in/out buttons bounded by the effective view zoom limits.

login.description: Bundled plugin adding login/logout navigation when login support is advertised by the page.

zoomToArea.description: Bundled plugin adding a drag-box zoom interaction.

test.description: Bundled plugin running requested core or integrity browser tests.

userIDB.description: Bundled developer plugin for editing the current user's IndexedDB record.

userLayer.description: Bundled developer plugin for adding an unsaved layer through XYZ's JSON editor.

userLocale.description: Bundled authenticated-user plugin for storing composed personal locales.

layers.description: Map layers keyed by their stable layer key.

locales.description: Keys of locale templates merged as nested locales.

mask.description: Mask the map outside the locale extent.

template.description: Workspace template merged into this layer.

src.description: Remote/file template source consumed during workspace composition.

gazetteer.description: Pinned XYZ layer-panel location search configuration.

provider.description: Name of a gazetteer utility supplied by additionally loaded code; pinned core only supplies database datasets.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the layer key.

display.description: Whether the layer is visible initially.

plugins.description: Optional plugin modules loaded for this layer.

group.description: Optional layer-list folder. XYZ groups layers that share this exact value for navigation only; group or folder order does not control map drawing order.

groupClassList.description: Optional deployed stylesheet class list applied to the XYZ layer-group drawer when this layer creates it. XYZ uses the first group member's value, so set the same verified class list on every member. A literal colour is not a class and has no effect.

groupmeta.description: Optional trusted HTML metadata shown for the group. The last grouped layer declaring it wins.

format.description: Layer renderer/data format exported by XYZ v4.23.4.

dbs.description: Database override; otherwise workspace.dbs is inherited.

srid.description: Geometry SRID. MVT specifically requires 3857 in XYZ v4.23.4.

_dashboard.description: Configuration-dashboard provenance hints ignored by XYZ.

URI.description: Tile URL template, normally containing {z}, {x}, and {y}.

source.description: OpenLayers tile-source constructor, commonly OSM or XYZ.

zIndex.description: Layer drawing order, independent of layer-list groups. Higher values render above lower values.

tables.description: Zoom-keyed PostgreSQL relations used instead of table.

geoms.description: Zoom-keyed geometry columns used instead of geom.

z_field.description: Optional column limiting MVT rows by zoom.

transition.description: OpenLayers source transition duration in milliseconds.

vectorImage.description: Use an OpenLayers VectorImage layer for vector formats.

features.description: Inline features passed directly to the selected featureFormat.

featureFormat.description: Feature response parser, normally geojson, wkt, cluster, wkth3, or wkt_properties.

featureLookup.description: Feature property lookup records used to restrict and style features.

wkt_properties.description: Load MVT properties separately using the WKT query.

infoj_skip.description: Entry keys, fields, queries, types, or groups skipped from infoj.

promoteDisplay.description: When shown, assign the layer a z-index above every currently displayed layer.

accessToken.description: Mapbox access token used by mapboxStyle or maplibre.

preserveDrawingBuffer.description: MapLibre canvas option required for screenshots.

viewport.description: Vector formats replace true with the current viewport.

z.description: Vector formats replace true with the current zoom.

key.description: Optional stable entry key; XYZ otherwise derives one from array order.

type.description: XYZ feature-information renderer. Omitted means text.

field.description: Unique result-field alias within this infoj array.

fieldfx.description: PostgreSQL expression selected as field. It must be a single trusted expression.

edit.description: Optional edit configuration; not enabled by this read-only deployment.

filter.description: Interactive layer-filter definition. True asks XYZ to infer a compatible filter from the info type.

style.description: Optional geometry-entry style. XYZ uses it for the selected geometry and renders the same style as a swatch or icon in feature information.

styleFromLayerDefault.description: Dashboard ownership marker for a geometry-entry style synchronized from layer.style.default.

default.description: Fallback value when the query value is undefined.

nullValue.description: Replacement value when the query result is null.

default.description: Fixed server-side filter composed with interactive filters. Use the validated deterministic object/OR-array form, or a separately reviewed trusted predicate string.

count_meta.description: Optional text displayed after the XYZ Filtering-panel feature count.

viewport_description.description: XYZ v4.23.4 workspace value preserved for compatibility; the pinned renderer constructs this note but leaves it hidden.

cache.description: Cache computed OpenLayers styles on features.

hidden.description: Suppress the interactive Styling panel without disabling feature rendering.

elements.description: Ordered XYZ layer-style UI element keys. An element renders only when its corresponding style property exists.

opacitySlider.description: Presence enables the opacitySlider style-panel element when that key is included in elements.

opacity.description: Opacity of the whole OpenLayers layer.

contextFilter.description: Canvas filter used by tile layers.

URL.description: Mapbox style URL used by mapboxStyle or maplibre.

scale.description: Legacy/top-level point scale. XYZ styleParser moves this into icon.scale for default styles.

highlightScale.description: Scale multiplier applied by XYZ when this feature style is used as style.highlight.

lineDash.description: OpenLayers stroke dash/gap sequence, for example [5, 4].

label.description: Label displayed beside a basic theme symbol in the XYZ legend.

dynamic.description: Disable XYZ hover response caching and query the value dynamically.

hidden.description: Hide the hover control from the XYZ layer style panel.

query.description: XYZ query template used when the hover field is not already present on the feature.

type.description: Built-in SVG symbol exported by XYZ v4.23.4.

fillColor.description: Used by dot, target, triangle, square, diamond, and semiCircle.

strokeColor.description: Used by the built-in circle symbol; ignored by dot.

strokeWidth.description: Used by the built-in circle symbol.

colorMarker.description: Outer marker colour used by markerColor.

colorDot.description: Inner dot colour used by markerColor.

url.description: Custom SVG/image URL consumed directly by XYZ and OpenLayers. Dashboard-managed SVGs use /instance/svg/<filename>.svg.

svg.description: Legacy XYZ alias for icon.url. XYZ normalizes this property to url while loading the workspace.

template.description: Named SVG template used when type is template.

substitute.description: String substitutions applied to an SVG template.
